text.nodata_description: It looks like you don't have any certificates. Get started by running a workflow.

page.heading: Certificates
page.subheading: SSL certificates contain the website's public key and the website's identity, along with related information. They are generated from the execution output of workflows.

search.input.placeholder: Search by certificate name or serial number ...

action.revoke.tencentcloud: Revoke in the Tencent Cloud console

revoke.modal.title: Revoke "{{name}}"
revoke.modal.content:
Are you sure want to revoke this certificate?
This action cannot be undone.

delete.modal.title: Delete "{{name}}"
delete.modal.content:
Are you sure want to delete this certificate?
This action cannot be undone.

batch_delete.modal.title: Delete certificates
batch_delete.modal.content:
Are you sure want to delete these {{count}} selected certificates?

pem.label: PEM (*.pem, *.crt, *.key)
pem.description: Suitable for most scenarios. Supported by servers like Apache, Nginx.

legacyrc2.label: LegacyRC2 (RC2, compatible with older systems, but less secure)

modern2023.label: Modern2023 (AES-256-CBC + SHA-256 MAC, compatible with OpenSSL v1.1.1+)

modern2026.label: Modern2026 (AES-256-CBC + PBMAC1 MAC, compatible with OpenSSL v3.4.0+)

compatibility.title: Android compatibility (estimated)
compatibility.idle: Enter a PEM certificate to assess Android compatibility
compatibility.deferred: Once the certificate is read, view Android compatibility on the SSL certificates page
compatibility.unavailable: Compatibility estimate unavailable; saving is unaffected
compatibility.scope: Assessed against AOSP system root stores. Actual connections also depend on the device, app and server configuration.

summary.not_trusted: Not trusted by assessed Android system roots
summary.invalid: Certificate chain invalid for this assessment

reason.trusted_system_root: The supplied chain reaches a root in this AOSP system store.
reason.supported_versions: The supplied chain is trusted in the listed Android versions.
reason.root_not_in_system_store: The chain root is absent from this system store.
reason.incomplete_chain: The chain may be incomplete; no complete trusted path was found.
reason.invalid_pem: The input is not a valid PEM certificate chain.
reason.invalid_certificate: The certificate could not be read.
reason.certificate_too_large: The certificate exceeds the analysis size limit.
reason.too_many_certificates: The chain exceeds the certificate count limit.
reason.not_yet_valid: A certificate in the chain is not yet valid.
reason.expired: A certificate in the chain has expired.
reason.invalid_server_auth_usage: The certificate is not valid for TLS server authentication.
reason.invalid_chain_constraints: The certificate chain did not pass validation.
reason.invalid_signature: A certificate signature could not be validated.
reason.unsupported_algorithm: Android compatibility cannot yet be assessed reliably for this certificate algorithm.
reason.unsupported_critical_extension: A critical extension in this certificate prevents a reliable assessment.
reason.unsupported_trust_anchor: A potentially matching historical root certificate cannot yet be assessed reliably.
reason.unsupported_certificate_format: This historical certificate format cannot yet be assessed reliably.
reason.analysis_limit: The certificate chain is too complex to complete this assessment.
reason.trust_anchor_validity_not_emulated: Historical Android versions handle root certificate validity differently, so this result is uncertain.
reason.certificate_not_found: The certificate was not found or is unavailable.
reason.other: Android compatibility cannot be determined reliably for this certificate.
